title: zoe group create / group plan --request-file
description: Frozen task-group plan request (TGD §5.1). The payload carries schema_version=2 for wire compatibility with the v1.2 ordered-group request; this document is version 1 of the *plan* contract. `expected_paths` is a planning hint, never an authorisation: the enforced scope stays project allowed_paths ∩ member spec allowed_paths.

schema_version.description: 2 for a dependency-graph plan. A request carrying `ordered_items` instead is a legacy record and cannot start.

request_id.description: Idempotency key: the same id + same payload replays the first answer.

design_files.description: Frozen design inputs; each file's sha256 enters design_digest.

delivery_mode.description: v1.3 closes out local_artifact only; pull_request is refused with CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED (kind=group_pr_unsupported).

follow_up_of.description: Set when this group revises an already integrated delivery: a new group, never an in-place edit.

max_starts.description: Billed start allowance. Required and never derived from the plan's size.

max_wall_seconds.description: Inclusive wall-clock ceiling (sleep and waiting included). null means no time limit and the response must say so.

max_group_repairs.description: Bounded group-repair rounds (TGD §9/§12). Absent or 0 means the plan authorises no repair execution at all; it is never derived from the member count. Each repair consumes one round and targets exactly one FAIL finding.

review.description: Design-conformance review (TGD §11.1 layer 2). When `required` is true the group cannot reach REVIEW_READY, and `group accept` is refused, until a valid review bound to the final integration_sha exists with no FAIL findings. Omitting this block keeps the v1.3 behaviour (structural coverage + checks only) — the runtime never injects the field, and `group create` warns when it is absent.

required.description: Defaults to true when the block is present.

mode.description: Who is expected to produce the review. The runtime validates the submitted output either way; it never runs the reviewer itself.

requirements.description: Every requirement must be owned by at least one member, or the plan is refused (kind=coverage_missing).

task_key.description: Unique safe id; also the member's name in every group response.

spec_file.description: Repository-relative spec path, read and frozen at creation into groups/<gid>/specs/<task_key>.json.

depends_on.description: Static edges over other task_keys. Cycles are refused before anything is written (kind=cycle).

expected_paths.description: Planning hint only: refuses escapes and paths outside every project allowed_paths directory, but never grants access.

requested_profile.description: Pins the routing candidate to one profile; it does not bypass admission.

group_checks.description: Check ids run once, on the final integration_sha. NOT_RUN and results for another SHA never count as passing.

allOf.description: A dependency graph needs at least one requirement to map onto.
